exactTOCHeading.sql: SELECT te.id,te.bookId,te.parentId,tt.text,te.lineId,l.lineIndex FROM tocEntry te JOIN tocText tt ON tt.id=te.textId JOIN line l ON l.id=te.lineId WHERE te.id=600
